title: Microwave Radiation Misunderstood

scenes.text: A 2024 kitchen test measured 2.45 GHz waves inside a standard microwave
People often say microwaves “nuke” food with dangerous radiation
scenes.label: Microwaves nuke food

scenes.text: The truth: microwaves use non‑ionizing microwave radiation that makes water molecules vibrate, heating food safely
scenes.label: Non‑ionizing water heating

scenes.text: Safe heating, not nuking – the waves simply excite water molecules
scenes.label: Safe heating
